Three Arrested in Uttar Pradesh for Robbery Ring

Police in Shravasti, Uttar Pradesh, have arrested three individuals accused of luring victims with friendship and then robbing them. The arrests followed the recovery of mobile phones and cash. In a separate incident in Noida, police apprehended four suspects involved in a similar car-based robbery scheme, recovering an iPhone-16 and other items.
